purpose: Inspect and reconcile Tesla Supercharger/DC billing history, spending, visited locations and site pricing, with invoice access and exports.
primaryGoal: Review real imported charging sessions for the selected vehicle or fleet, understand cost and usage, sync Tesla records and download billing evidence.

dataSources.name: Tesla charging history
dataSources.behavior: Typed entries and all-time summary; VIN-specific or fleet query key; SLOW stale time; forwards AbortSignal; enabled after vehicle initial loading. Range and search are local transformations, not request bounds.
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Hook documents local database reads. Backend handler/query implementation was not inspected; ordering, completeness, currency normalization and server aggregation remain unknown.

dataSources.name: Tesla history refresh
dataSources.behavior: Page sends optional VIN only. Hook additionally accepts start_time/end_time; successful mutation invalidates both history and site-ranking key families and uses mutation toasts. Router has five-per-minute IP limit. Pending button is disabled. No mutation was executed.

dataSources.name: Site price ranking
dataSources.behavior: Independent VIN-backed source; SLOW stale time and AbortSignal; renders first eight sites, visit count/last visit, realized price per kWh, unpriced visit count and cheapest-to-priciest spread within those eight. No range bounds passed; server source scope/ordering not independently verified.

dataSources.name: Invoice download
dataSources.behavior: Encoded opaque invoice ID in direct anchor URL; full API prefix is intentional because this does not use request(). Link only exists when has_invoice and invoice_content_id are both truthy; new tab has noopener noreferrer.

dataSources.name: Vehicle scope
dataSources.behavior: Existing workspace owner bridged to VIN endpoints; vin=* is explicit fleet override, bookmarks promote valid VIN into numeric scope, unresolved override is cleared after fleet resolution. Duplicate hook invocations do not establish duplicate network requests; shared QueryClient execution was not tested.
dataSources.sourceOwnership: Only useVehicles query snippet inspected; /vehicles backend route was not checked in this bounded audit.

dataSources.name: Range, URL filters and display preferences
dataSources.behavior: Header-owned dated and vehicle-enabled route. Page reads calendar start/end, URL q/sort/dir and saved formatting/currency preferences. Wh remains raw in hook/cache/exports; energy formatting occurs at display. Formatter internals and preference subscriptions were not traced.

components.contract: Existing PageContainer adapter with title/subtitle/query/copyLink/contextActions/primaryAction; full-width min-w-0 composition. Three named cards use title/actions/children and shared Card surface/heading.

Six typed StatMetric measurements with specialist formatter overrides; unknown period reason states lifetime versus loaded-record scope. Retained/loading/status/partial/missing handling goes through existing useOperationalMetrics and OperationalBrief. Shared OperationalBrief source not inspected.

Canonical ChartContainer embedded adapter, chart title/ariaLabel, raw monthly exportData/dataColumns, export and fullscreen opt-ins, fixed desktop 288/mobile 224 height; category-barrel Recharts exports.

Label/value/max/color/sublabel; existing solid fill option avoids new renderer. Progress semantics, null reading handling and reduced-motion hook are source-present; page feeds precomputed spend/count.
vin/enabled; shared GlassPanel/PanelTitle/Text/Caption, independent loading/error/retry/empty and priced/unpriced evidence. No competing generic ranking component proposed.

Stable tableId tesla-charging-history, seven columns, URL sorting, value filters, column visibility/reorder, sticky header, 600 maxHeight, virtualized 56px rows, pagination 25/50/100, exportRow, multi-selection and localized rowLabel. Existing mobilePresentation and embedded variant available; current page supplies neither.

components.owner: Existing @/components/ui, forms, motion and feedback category owners
components.contract: Reuse present owners for localized controls, filtering, motion and source states. Implementations were not recursively audited.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page hand-builds selected CSV Blob/download at 325-355 while DataTable already owns CSV/JSON exports and selected-row scope. Serializers also differ: duration_minutes/energy_wh versus duration/energy, with different site sanitization.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing table selected export pipeline only after preserving both current field schemas, raw SI, selection scope and filename behavior; if both formats remain intentional, keep explicitly named actions rather than silently deleting one.

sourceStrategy: PageLayout retains min-w-0 and full-width allocation; page uses one column until 2xl then a three-column grid with spending/sessions spanning two columns and top locations/Price Radar in third: page lines 444-524.
Vehicle Select is w-full below sm, sm:w-44; refresh uses wrapLabel: page lines 389-405.
Search is w-full/sm:w-72; embedded chart explicitly uses mobileHeight 224 and height 288: page lines 469-470,537-543.
Date/location/energy/cost are mobile-visible; table owner hides other columns below md: page lines 183-242; DataTable lines 716-725.

issues.detail: Mobile allow-list hides duration and invoice below md; rate is default-hidden everywhere. No mobilePresentation, expanded detail renderer or equivalent mobile invoice action is supplied. Source proves hiding, not actual device reachability via column controls.
issues.fix: Use existing DataTable mobilePresentation/detail capabilities or an explicit reachable detail action retaining all seven columns and invoices; preserve tableId, sorting, selections, pagination, filters and both exports.

responsive.unverified: All requested widths 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, allocated container widths, 200% text, long location names, RTL and overflow require mounted QA.

sourcePositives: KPI section has localized aria-label (430); chart has localized ariaLabel and dataColumns (459-467).
Vehicle Select has localized aria-label (394); icons used decoratively set aria-hidden; invoice anchor has localized accessible name (263).
Selection rowLabel combines site/date and localized unknown-site fallback (593-600); no bare-date-only checkbox labels.
Shared MetricBar has progressbar semantics and reduced-motion source handling (MetricBar 58-62,95-97).

issues.detail: Inline invoice link has 3.5-size icon and xs text with no explicit minimum target dimensions; its accessible label is identical across rows. Effective target size and table-cell context are unmeasured.
issues.fix: Retain native download navigation, use existing button/link chrome with 44px reachability where appropriate, and include site/date in localized action name without replacing the invoice URL.

issues.detail: formatDurationMinutes emits literal h/m units rather than locale-aware duration text. Both table and duration KPI use it; these labels are outside t().
issues.fix: Adopt existing locale-aware duration formatting only if exact rounding and hour/minute display are preserved; localize fallback labels through current catalogs, with any missing catalog work assigned separately.

Chart/table alternatives in open fullscreen/export states

states.history: useDataState historical provenance (121) supplies fatalError only; StaleRefreshWarning (407), refresh-blocked/no-data unavailable notice (408-412), firstLoading (360), independent persistent sections and panel retries (448-454,492-498,525-531) preserve retained history instead of blanking on ordinary refresh failure. KPI retained state is passed at 432.
states.empty: History unavailable distinct from loaded-empty chart/location/table at 455-456,499-500,532-536; search mismatch uses separate message at 619-621.
states.mutation: Refresh pending disables its button and displays Syncing with animated icon (401-405); hook success/error toasts and invalidation present (245-251). Offline execution not tested.
states.priceRadar: Independent initial loading/error/retry/empty at SitePriceRadar 33-41; no shared DataState adapter used.

issues.detail: isError replaces site rows with QueryError even if query retains prior data; no refresh warning or unavailable/paused state is distinguished. This differs from the main historical source trust policy.
issues.fix: Use existing useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning; replace rows only for fatal no-data failure, retain site evidence on refresh error and expose paused/unavailable state with independent retry.

issues.detail: Last synced uses entries[0].fetched_at from range-filtered rows, not an explicit source sync timestamp or max across records. Changing the analysis range can hide/change this source-freshness label; backend ordering and timestamp semantics unverified.
issues.fix: Determine documented source timestamp semantics; preserve fetched_at metadata but do not label a selected row as global freshness without evidence. Prefer actual source metadata or a clearly row-scoped label.

issues.detail: Monthly spending and top-location rollups substitute zero for missing total_due (67,89); total duration sums missing/invalid durations as zero (146). Therefore a row/bucket with unknown bills can appear as measured zero, and partial duration has no missing-count evidence. Sites count includes unpriced entries.
issues.fix: Retain every record and existing aggregate calculation pending explicitly approved business changes; expose priced/missing counts and partial duration evidence rather than upgrading unknowns to trustworthy zero. Preserve known zero as distinct from missing.

visualIssues.detail: Top-location bars assign a different fixed chartTokens.series hue to each ranked site, creating up to six saturated decorative colors with no category/meaning legend. Default MetricBar fill adds a gradient. Token series values are fixed hex at tokens.ts:401.
visualIssues.fix: Use a single restrained existing semantic/theme hue for spend ranking and MetricBar fill='solid'; retain ordering, amounts, count labels and all six sites. Do not modify user-selected palettes or global tokens from this page.

visualIssues.detail: Energy and cost body values use fixed cyan-300/emerald-300 (216,230), decorative card icons use cyan-300 (447,491), and invoice link uses cyan-300 (262). Price Radar uses the same fixed hues (29,57). These are not neon class names, but fixed-hue accent repetition is source-level noise and effective light/dark contrast is unknown.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing theme-aware primary/secondary text roles for routine data and decorative icons; reserve restrained semantic emphasis for meaningful cheapest-site status and navigable invoice action.

visualIssues.detail: Single-series monthly spending has a fixed cyan series gradient at opacity 0.6. This is source-confirmed decoration, not a measured visual or contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse a restrained existing chart color/fill contract without changing monthly data, axes, tooltip, responsive sizing, accessible columns, fullscreen or export controls.

architectureIssues.detail: Page reconstructs browser-local midnight and 23:59:59.999 from calendar start/end instead of consuming useRangeState startInstant/endInstantExclusive. Rolling scopes such as 24h lose exact instants; timezone supplied by the shared range owner is bypassed. Hook only supports VIN read scope and no range bounds are sent.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume shared precise instants and exclusive upper bound; coordinate typed hook/backend filtering extension rather than claiming server support. Keep lifetime summary and loaded-record duration/sites explicitly separate from scoped charts/table; preserve all records and import mutation semantics.

architectureIssues.detail: Page contextActions renders a second vehicle Select despite /tesla-charging-history being registered as vehicle-enabled (workspaceScope.ts:130) and useVehicleVinFilter sharing workspace state. VIN fleet override semantics are important and cannot simply be dropped.
architectureIssues.fix: Use shell-owned vehicle scope without duplicate selector; first verify the header supports explicit fleet selection and VIN bookmark promotion. If unsupported, extend the canonical owner before removing the page action.

architectureIssues.detail: Monthly and location sums combine total_due without currency_code grouping, then display in saved user currency (479,510). Table correctly preserves per-row currency (225-234). Server summary and price ranking normalization are unknown; no currency conversion is visible in these local sums.
architectureIssues.fix: Establish backend/source currency guarantees before any aggregate redesign; retain each row currency and expose mixed/unknown currency evidence. Do not invent FX conversion or silently relabel heterogeneous sums as one currency.

architectureIssues.detail: 629-line page combines date/ranking transforms, duration helpers, column rendering, sorting, browser download code and page orchestration. These exported helpers are business/presentation transformations, not additional exported React components.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract narrowly scoped typed feature helpers/column presentation only when authorized; retain exported helper compatibility and all sections. Use page plus extracted component totals for preservation, not deletion to hit a size target.

priority.reason: Resolve range/workspace consistency, hidden mobile invoice/detail preservation and independent source trust before cosmetic adoption; source currency and unknown-as-zero risks need evidence rather than aesthetic rewrites.

dataBehavior: Preserve optional VIN/fleet scope, valid VIN bookmark handling, query keys, enablement, SLOW stale time, read cancellation and refresh invalidation of both independent sources.

Preserve typed nullable billing fields and all record metadata: session/id/VIN/location/start/stop/country/state/county/postal/billing/fee/currency/pricing/rate/Wh/amount/invoice/fetched_at/created_at. Do not remove non-rendered metadata from payload/cache.
Lifetime server summary is distinct from all-loaded-record duration/sites and locally ranged chart/table. Preserve this explicit scope explanation; any range correction requires verified equivalence.

Monthly buckets use local year/month, skip malformed timestamp buckets, sort ascending; location rollup sorts descending spend and keeps six, accumulating energyWh/count. Keep exported helpers and their behavior until approved correction.
Duration currently rounds positive finite timestamp difference to minutes; null stop/invalid/nonpositive is unknown. KPI exposes seconds to StatMetric with specialist duration formatter.

Wh values are raw in source/cache and exports, display conversion uses useUnits; invoices and per-row currency/rate/source pricing labels remain source-owned. Do not rename wire fields or invent monetary conversion.
Search covers site_location_name; sorting operates on a copy, date lexical order and missing numeric sort values currently zero. Selected session IDs and stable tableId remain unchanged.

Preserve both current export field sets, null handling, filenames, selected versus matching-loaded row scopes and download behavior; resolve duplicate controller without deleting an export capability.
Price Radar remains independent, first eight sites, visit/date context, unpriced count and within-displayed-sites spread; range behavior is not inferred.
